title: Project 4 · Code Editor Component (Monaco)
summary: A reusable Monaco wrapper — the same architecture this app ships in CodeEditor.vue.
requirements: Offline worker wiring via ?worker import; lazy main-library import
v-model:value support with external-change watch guard
Theme sync from settings store; fontSize/tabSize updateOptions live
Ctrl+Enter emits run; dispose() on unmount (no leaked editors)

milestones.title: Two-way value
milestones.detail: Watch prop → setValue only when different (cursor safety).

milestones.title: Theming
milestones.detail: defineThemes once; setTheme on store change.

starterFiles.name: CodeEditor.vue
starterFiles.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import EditorWorker from 'monaco-editor/esm/vs/editor/editor.worker?worker'
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'

;(self as unknown as { MonacoEnvironment?: object }).MonacoEnvironment = {
  getWorker: () => new EditorWorker()
}

const props = defineProps<{ value: string; language: string }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'update:value', v: string): void; (e: 'run'): void }>()

const host = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
let editor: { getValue(): string; setValue(v: string): void } | null = null

onMounted(async () => {
  const monaco = await import('monaco-editor')
  const created = monaco.editor.create(host.value!, {
    value: props.value,
    language: props.language,
    automaticLayout: true
  })
  created.onDidChangeModelContent(() => emit('update:value', created.getValue()))
  created.addCommand(monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.Enter, () => emit('run'))
  editor = created
})

watch(() => props.value, (v) => {
  if (editor && editor.getValue() !== v) editor.setValue(v)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  // real impl: editor.dispose()
})
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="host" style="height: 300px" role="region" aria-label="Code editor" />
</template>

hints: The guard `getValue() !== v` prevents cursor jumps on programmatic updates.
Keep monaco types as `typeof import('monaco-editor')` for accuracy.
Dispose models too when swapping languages dynamically.
completionCriteria: Component reusable across three consumers without prop drift
Typing feels native (no .value leaks into template)
